apply_source_workflow.py.text:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Only replace the reviewed source job; never run project code."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def source_bounds(text):
    start = re.search(r"^  source:\n", text, re.M)
    if start is None:
        raise ValueError("exact source job missing")
    tail = re.search(r"^  [A-Za-z0-9_-]+:\s*$", text[start.end():], re.M)
    if tail is None:
        raise ValueError("next top-level job missing")
    return start.start(), start.end() + tail.start()

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--workflow", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--fragment", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--report", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.workflow.resolve() == args.output.resolve():
        raise ValueError("write a separate reviewable output; do not overwrite the input")
    before_bytes = args.workflow.read_bytes()
    fragment_bytes = args.fragment.read_bytes()
    plan = json.loads(args.plan.read_bytes())
    if digest(fragment_bytes) != plan["after_fragment"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("frozen source fragment identity differs")
    before = before_bytes.decode("utf-8")
    fragment = fragment_bytes.decode("utf-8")
    begin, end = source_bounds(before)
    observed = before[begin:end].encode("utf-8")
    admitted = [name for name, identity in plan["original_source_blocks"].items()
                if digest(observed) == identity["sha256"] and len(observed) == identity["bytes"]]
    if len(admitted) != 1:
        raise ValueError("source job must match exactly one frozen original; author a new explicit delta otherwise")
    after = before[:begin] + fragment + before[end:]
    if after[:begin] != before[:begin] or after[begin + len(fragment):] != before[end:]:
        raise AssertionError("outside-source content changed")
    after_bytes = after.encode("utf-8")
    report = {
        "schema": "hepta.source-workflow-apply-observation.v1",
        "status": "AUTHORED_APPLIED_NOT_QUALIFIED",
        "input_workflow_sha256": digest(before_bytes),
        "original_source_job": admitted[0],
        "original_source_job_sha256": digest(observed),
        "output_workflow_sha256": digest(after_bytes),
        "source_fragment_sha256": digest(fragment_bytes),
        "prefix_sha256": digest(before[:begin].encode()),
        "suffix_sha256": digest(before[end:].encode()),
        "outside_source_exact": True,
        "generators": len(plan["generators"]),
        "selectors": len(plan["selectors"]),
        "tests_executed": 0,
        "diff": "".join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(keepends=True),
                                            after.splitlines(keepends=True),
                                            fromfile="before.yml", tofile="after.yml")),
    }
    with args.output.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(after_bytes)
    if args.output.read_bytes() != after_bytes:
        raise AssertionError("output readback differs")
    with args.report.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in report.items() if key != "diff"},
                     sort_keys=True))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Review source registration and, only when requested, load real test IDs.

This never calls unittest.run or any test body. Imports during --load use the
integrated source checkout and its real installed dependencies.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import ast
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import unittest

def flatten(suite):
    for item in suite:
        if isinstance(item, unittest.TestSuite):
            yield from flatten(item)
        else:
            yield item

def load_names(names):
    loader = unittest.TestLoader()
    suite = loader.loadTestsFromNames(names)
    return [test.id() for test in flatten(suite)], list(loader.errors)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--source", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--fragment", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--load", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    plan = json.loads(args.plan.read_bytes())
    fragment = args.fragment.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(fragment).hexdigest() != plan["after_fragment"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("fragment identity differs")
    text = fragment.decode("utf-8")
    begin = text.index("          names = (\n")
    end = text.index("          )\n", begin) + len("          )\n")
    names_source = "\n".join(line[10:] for line in text[begin:end].splitlines())
    node = ast.parse(names_source)
    if len(node.body) != 1 or not isinstance(node.body[0], ast.Assign):
        raise ValueError("names must remain one literal assignment")
    selectors = list(ast.literal_eval(node.body[0].value))
    match = re.search(r"^\s+for component in ([^\n;]+); do$", text, re.M)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError("generator loop missing")
    generators = match.group(1).split()
    if selectors != plan["selectors"] or generators != plan["generators"]:
        raise ValueError("workflow registration differs from exact reviewed plan")
    if len(set(selectors)) != len(selectors) or len(set(generators)) != len(generators):
        raise ValueError("duplicate selector or generator")
    if generators[:len(plan["main_generators"])] != plan["main_generators"]:
        raise ValueError("main generator order lost")
    if selectors[:len(plan["main_selectors"])] != plan["main_selectors"]:
        raise ValueError("main selector order lost")
    if "expected = suite.countTestCases()" not in text:
        raise ValueError("original loaded/executed gate missing")
    for needle in ("result.testsRun == expected and expected > 0",
                   "result.errors or result.failures or result.skipped or",
                   "result.expectedFailures or result.unexpectedSuccesses"):
        if needle not in text:
            raise ValueError("original strict result predicate changed")
    files = {}
    for name in generators:
        relative = "tools/generate_hia_" + name + ".py"
        data = (args.source / relative).read_bytes()
        ast.parse(data, filename=relative)
        files[relative] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    for name in selectors:
        components = name.split(".")
        relative = "/".join(components[:2]) + ".py"
        data = (args.source / relative).read_bytes()
        ast.parse(data, filename=relative)
        files[relative] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    report = {
        "schema": "hepta.source-selection-review.v1",
        "status": "STATIC_REGISTRATION_REVIEW",
        "source": str(args.source.resolve()),
        "generator_order": generators,
        "selector_order": selectors,
        "read_source_sha256": files,
        "actual_loader_requested": args.load,
        "test_bodies_executed": 0,
        "qualification": False,
    }
    if args.load:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(args.source.resolve()))
        actual, errors = load_names(selectors)
        main_ids, main_errors = load_names(plan["main_selectors"])
        mapped_a733 = [plan["selector_renames"].get(name, name)
                       for name in plan["a733_selectors"]]
        a733_ids, a733_errors = load_names(mapped_a733)
        counts = Counter(actual)
        duplicate_ids = {name: count for name, count in counts.items() if count != 1}
        missing_main = list((Counter(main_ids) - counts).elements())
        missing_a733 = list((Counter(a733_ids) - counts).elements())
        report.update({
            "actual_ordered_ids": actual,
            "actual_loaded": len(actual),
            "main_projection_ids": main_ids,
            "mapped_a733_projection_ids": a733_ids,
            "duplicate_ids": duplicate_ids,
            "loader_errors": {"merged": errors, "main": main_errors, "a733": a733_errors},
            "missing_main_ids": missing_main,
            "missing_mapped_a733_ids": missing_a733,
        })
        clean = not (errors or main_errors or a733_errors or duplicate_ids or
                     missing_main or missing_a733) and bool(actual)
        report["status"] = "DISCOVERY_ONLY_PASS" if clean else "DISCOVERY_ONLY_FAIL"
    else:
        clean = True
    for relative, expected in files.items():
        if hashlib.sha256((args.source / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
            raise ValueError("source changed during review: " + relative)
    report["read_source_unchanged"] = True
    with args.output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"status": report["status"],
                      "generators": len(generators), "selectors": len(selectors),
                      "actual_loaded": report.get("actual_loaded"),
                      "test_bodies_executed": 0}, sort_keys=True))
    raise SystemExit(0 if clean else 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
